children: New York intimates retailer and brand
replaces fragmented workflows with a unified platform to support multi-brand growth

CAMPBELL, Calif., Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Centric Software® is pleased to share the success story of Journelle, a New York-based intimates retailer and brand, which has implemented Centric PLM™ to centralize product development and support scalable growth across multiple brands. Centric Software delivers innovative, integrated, end-to-end AI-powered enterprise solutions to take products from concept to commercialization. Fashion, luxury, footwear, outdoor, home, cosmetics and personal care as well as multi-category retail teams can plan, design, develop, source, comply, buy, make, price, allocate, assort, sell and replenish products to achieve strategic and operational digital transformation goals.

Founded in 2007, Journelle operates retail stores and a growing e-commerce business while curating third-party brands alongside its own collections. As the business expanded across categories and regions, Journelle needed a centralized system to manage growing product complexity.
"As we evolved, it became clear that spreadsheets and emails were no longer enough," says Courtney Green, Co-founder and co-owner of Made in Mediterraneo and Production Manager of Journelle.

Journelle sought a PLM solution that could centralize product data, connect teams and align with the unique demands of the intimates category. After exploring its options, the company selected Centric PLM for its flexibility, category alignment and ability to bring teams together around a single source of truth.

With Centric PLM, Journelle now organizes collections in one platform, centralizes product information and enables faster, more aligned decision-making across teams, following an implementation completed in approximately 14 weeks. This shift replaces fragmented workflows with a single, reliable source of truth that drives day-to-day operations and future growth. The Journelle team has also newly added Centric AI Studio™, bringing AI-powered design and visual content creation into the same platform to further streamline product development and consumer-facing content workflows.

"Journelle's approach to modernizing product development reflects a clear focus on building a data driven foundation for long-term growth." says Fabrice Canonge, CEO of Centric Software. "We are proud to partner with Journelle as it builds a more connected and scalable product development process."
Discover how Journelle replaced disconnected spreadsheets and emails with a unified platform that drives faster decisions, stronger coordination and multi-brand growth.

Journelle is a New York-based intimates retailer and brand known for its curated approach to lingerie, sleepwear and loungewear. Journelle combines third-party collections with its own designs, creating a distinct point of view in the intimates market.
